messages:
anna: Heads-up: Dedicated capacity update — new GPU SKUs and region expansion rolling out this week.

anna: Summary: GH200 (128GB, amp-q4_0) is available in eu-central-1 and us-east-1 as Dedicated SKUs. H100 (80GB) inventory added to ap-northeast-1 as burst/warm pool. Documentation + perf numbers uploaded to the internal KB: https://redwood.internal/dedicated/gh200-launch

kevin: Quick Q: what's GH200 good for compared to H100? thinking about our long-context models.

anna: GH200 shows better memory headroom for >32k contexts and high-batch workloads. For short-context, cost/perf similar to H100. See perf table in KB (latency/throughput by seq length).

ops-bot: [system] Inventory snapshot: GH200-us-east-1: 16 units, GH200-eu-central-1: 12 units, H100-ap-northeast-1 (warm): 10 units. Live counts available at /dedicated/inventory.

marco: Is GH200 enabled for both reserved Dedicated and for Dedicated trial clusters?

anna: Enabled for both. Trials limited to 2 concurrent test nodes per team. Reserved contracts can request GH200 allocation via the capacity-change flow. Lead time 3-8 weeks depending on region.

zara: Anything changed about routing/fallbacks? We need deterministic behavior for enterprise SLAs.

anna: Added routing policy "preferred_gpu" with deterministic fallback chains: GH200 -> H100 -> A100-mix. Also can set hard-pinned policy in Console to prevent fallbacks.

ben: Pricing delta?

anna: GH200 reserved multiplier is 1.8x vs our A100 baseline; H100 warm/burst pricing is 1.5x for burst units. Detailed pricing examples per 10M tokens in the KB.

kevin: How do I validate that my endpoint will actually schedule on GH200 in our Dedicated zone?

anna: Use Console Blueprints or CLI:
```
rw dedicated plan --region eu-central-1 --gpu GH200 --model ./models/long-context-65k
```
returns PLAN_OK + estimated throughput. If capacity insufficient you'll get FALLBACK_PLAN with recommended alternatives.

marco: Any limits customers should know about (quota, burst behavior)?

anna: Yes: ap-northeast-1 H100 is warm pool: burstable but not guaranteed for sustained capacity. GH200 regions currently have per-tenant soft quotas; raise requests via support with commit details.

ops-bot: [system] GH200 test cluster: request via /ops request gh200-test {team: <name>}. Auto-provision up to 3 seats.

zara: Please add a short note for Sales & Solutions with example TCO for common configs.

anna: On it — drafting a one-pager and pinging Sales. Will post public changelog blurb after legal signoff.

kevin: Thanks! planning to move our canary of conversation summarizer to GH200 next week.

anna: Great — ping me if you need help with batching profile or kv-cache tuning.
